title: Prediction and visual analysis of flue-cured tobacco aroma types based on machine learning and feature derivation
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,27308-27318
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00543H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhiying Wang, Shouchen Yang, Xiaoting Wang, Jun Qiu, Jianmin Cao, Xianwei Hao
The present study aimed to investigate the relationship between aroma types and chemical properties of flue-cured tobacco (FCT), and to explore the applicability of machine learning (ML) combined with feature derivation in the FCT industry.
